mapper.sql: j.analysis_id AS "analysisId" , j.project_id AS "projectId" , j.revision_id AS "revisionId" , r.revision_label AS "revisionLabel" , j.job_type AS "jobType" , j.status AS "status" , j.current_pass AS "currentPass" , j.total_files AS "totalFiles" , j.done_files AS "doneFiles" , j.error_message AS "errorMessage" , to_char(j.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "startedAt" , to_char(j.ended_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "endedAt" , to_char(j.heartbeat_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "heartbeatAt" , to_char(j.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt"
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(analysis_id FROM 10) AS INT)), 0) FROM analysis_job WHERE analysis_id LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_job (analysis_id, project_id, revision_id, job_type, status) VALUES (#{analysisId}, #{projectId}, #{revisionId}, 'ANALYZE', 'READY')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM analysis_job j JOIN analysis_revision r ON r.revision_id = j.revision_id WHERE j.analysis_id = #{analysisId}
SELECT FROM analysis_job j JOIN analysis_revision r ON r.revision_id = j.revision_id WHERE j.revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.analysis_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_job WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_job WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_job SET status = 'RUNNING' , started_at = now() , heartbeat_at = now() WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}
UPDATE analysis_job SET status = 'FAILED' , error_message = #{errorMessage} , ended_at = now() WHERE status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_error (analysis_id, revision_id, file_id, pass, error_type, message, detail, line_start) VALUES (#{analysisId}, #{revisionId}, #{fileId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{pass}, #{errorType}, #{message}, #{detail}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_error WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}

SELECT error_id AS "errorId" , pass AS "pass" , error_type AS "errorType" , message AS "message" , detail AS "detail" , file_id AS "fileId" , line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_error WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} ORDER BY error_id LIMIT #{limit}
